hookups.source: https://www.mywakulla.com/departments/parks/newport_campground.php ('Site accommodations are varied and include Full Hook-Up, Water & Electric, Electric Only or Primitive Dry', 'Full Hook-Up (Water, Electric & Sewer) $31.00 per night'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 28 sites in the county's booking catalog: 10 full hook-up, 7 water & electric, 3 primitive with electric and 8 primitive. Listed pad sizes run from about 10 x 23 ft to 16 x 65 ft (several 40-50 ft deep), so pick a site by its posted dimensions.

sites.source: https://secure.rec1.com/FL/wakulla-county-fl/catalog?filter=bG9jYXRpb25bMzE1MzldPTE= (sites #02-#29, e.g. '#08 Campsite, Full Hook Up (16' W x 40' D)', '#29 Campsite, Electric & Water (16' W x 65' D)'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://secure.rec1.com/FL/wakulla-county-fl/catalog?filter=bG9jYXRpb25bMzE1MzldPTE= ('Bathhouse with showers and restrooms', 'A dump station is available on site') + https://www.mywakulla.com/departments/parks/newport_campground.php ('Bathhouse with showers and restrooms'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve by site through Wakulla County's Rec1 catalog ('Click Here to Reserve a Campsite'). Stays over 7 nights: add the weekly rate to the cart first. Cancellations less than 48 hours out get a 50% refund (policy effective October 1, 2025).

booking.source: https://www.mywakulla.com/departments/parks/newport_campground.php ('Click Here to Reserve a Campsite' -> secure.rec1.com) + https://secure.rec1.com/FL/wakulla-county-fl/catalog?filter=bG9jYXRpb25bMzE1MzldPTE= ('*When reserving for more than 7 days, add the weekly rate to the cart separately', 'Cancellations made less than 48 hours prior to the reservation will receive a 50% refund'), read 2026-10-21. Cleared the note-derived fcfs 'always' (no county page mentions walk-up or self-pay camping) and changed reservable false -> true.

note: Wakulla County campground on the St. Marks River near the Newport Bridge, across from St. Marks NWR; boat ramp, dock, kayak launch, pavilion, and a short nature path to a river observation deck. --Claude
summary: County page and Rec1 catalog: confirmed water/sewer at full hook-up sites, showers, dump, and the $15-$31 fees (2026, unchanged). Changed reservable false -> true (now booked online by site through Rec1), cleared the note-derived fcfs, site count 29 -> 28 (catalog). Note trimmed of field facts and the outdated FCFS/self-pay line. Not stated: electric amperage, pull-throughs, max rig length, season.
flags: Phone: the entry's 850-925-4530 appears on neither county page; the Rec1 catalog gives 850-745-7780 (Wakulla County Board of County Commissioners main line 850-926-0919).

Waterfront re-audit lead: the county says the campground is 'nestled along the St. Marks River'; the entry is 'not waterfront', and the same page's 'short nature path will lead you to an observation deck' suggests the sites sit back from the river.
No Hurricane Isaias closure notice on the county page or the Rec1 catalog as of 2026-10-21.
